title: Fix X failing with 'Failing initialization of X screen'
summary: If Xorg fails to initialize the screen and nvidia-smi shows no processes, update nvidia-utils and configure the primary GPU.

aliases.text: gpu screens are not yet supported

error_patterns: GPU screens are not yet supported by the NVIDIA driver
prerequisites: You are using the proprietary NVIDIA driver.

steps.explain: Update the nvidia-utils package to the latest version.
Copy the default output class configuration to the system Xorg directory.
Edit /etc/X11/xorg.conf.d/10-nvidia-drm-outputclass.conf and add the line 'Option "PrimaryGPU" "yes"' inside the Device section.

warnings: Ensure you are using the proprietary driver, not the open-source one.
